title: Process Tasks in Arrival Order
statement: Given a list of tasks arriving over time, describe or simulate processing the oldest task first.
think: What is the task asking? Given a list of tasks arriving over time, describe or simulate processing the oldest task first.
What is the key operation? Identify the repeated action over the input.
What wording signals stand out? arrival order, oldest first, FIFO.
What is the brute force idea? Use extra loops or repeated checks.
What is the better/optimal idea? Use a clean queue solution.
What are the edge cases? Empty-like input, single values, duplicates, and boundaries.
What is the complexity? For most of these easy tasks, aim for O(n) time unless sorting is required.
How would I explain it in an interview? State the pattern, the key operation, and the complexity.
algorithm: Dequeue from the front to process
interview: I would solve it using Queue. I would first identify the core operation, then apply a simple queue approach and mention the complexity.
ru: Это фундаментальное понимание Queue: first in, first out.
